    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $all = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process)

    $marker = '--app-scaling-browser-owner=26f98a3a-ccaf-4435-bd2d-15f163f7c816'
    $runtime = 'C:\Users\chhage\repos\app-scaling-strategies\.git\kanban-orchestrator\browser-runtime'
    $roots = @($all | Where-Object {
      $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.Contains($marker) -and (
        ('Browser' -eq 'Browser' -and $_.CommandLine.IndexOf($runtime, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch '--type=') -or
        ('Browser' -eq 'Test' -and $_.ProcessId -eq 0 -and $_.ParentProcessId -eq 0)
      )
    })
    $owned = @{}
    foreach ($root in $roots) { $owned[[int]$root.ProcessId] = $root }
    $iterations = 0
    do {
      $added = $false
      foreach ($candidate in $all) {
        if ($owned.ContainsKey([int]$candidate.ParentProcessId) -and -not $owned.ContainsKey([int]$candidate.ProcessId) -and
            $candidate.CreationDate -ge $owned[[int]$candidate.ParentProcessId].CreationDate) {
          $owned[[int]$candidate.ProcessId] = $candidate
          $added = $true
        }
      }
      $iterations++
      if ($iterations -gt 32) { throw 'Owned process ancestry exceeded its strict traversal bound' }
    } while ($added)
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine("owned-graph:roots=$($roots.Count),members=$($owned.Count)")
    $stopped = @()
    $identityMismatches = @()
    $ordered = @($owned.Values | Sort-Object CreationDate -Descending)
    foreach ($candidate in $ordered) {
      [Console]::Error.WriteLine("owned-stop-start:$($candidate.ProcessId)")
      $process = Get-Process -Id ([int]$candidate.ProcessId) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($process -and -not $process.HasExited) {
        try {
          $nativeCreation = $process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddHHmmss.ffffff')
          $expectedCreation = $candidate.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddHHmmss.ffffff')
          if ($nativeCreation -eq $expectedCreation) {
            Stop-Process -Id ([int]$candidate.ProcessId) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $stopped += [int]$candidate.ProcessId
          } else {
            $identityMismatches += [int]$candidate.ProcessId
          }
        } catch {}
      }
      [Console]::Error.WriteLine("owned-stop-end:$($candidate.ProcessId)")
    }
    $remaining = @()
    foreach ($candidate in $owned.Values) {
      $process = Get-Process -Id ([int]$candidate.ProcessId) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($process -and -not $process.HasExited) {
        $current = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($candidate.ProcessId)"
        if ($current -and $current.CreationDate -eq $candidate.CreationDate) { $remaining += [int]$current.ProcessId }
      }
    }
    [ordered]@{owner='26f98a3a-ccaf-4435-bd2d-15f163f7c816';kind='Browser';roots=@($roots | ForEach-Object {[int]$_.ProcessId});ownedProcessIds=@($owned.Keys);stoppedProcessIds=$stopped;remainingProcessIds=$remaining;identityMismatches=$identityMismatches} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4
